name: @pipeworx/mcp-musicbrainz

tools.name: search_artists
tools.description: Search for music artists by name. Returns artist IDs, names, types, and countries. Use get_artist to fetch full discography and biographical details.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: Get artist details including biography, country, founding date, and complete release list. Requires artist ID from search_artists.

tools.name: search_releases
tools.description: Search for albums and releases by title or artist name. Returns release IDs, titles, artists, release dates, and formats.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Get release details: full track listing, credits, media formats, and metadata. Requires release ID from search_releases.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-musicbrainz forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the musicbrainz pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
